sections.content: Use *creo* *que*, *considero* que and me *parece* que to express political opinions. Evaluation can be strengthened with expressions such as es *importante*, es positivo, es *preocupante* and es difícil.

items.spanish: Creo que la propuesta es positiva.
items.english: I think the proposal is positive.

items.spanish: Considero que la medida es eficaz.
Me parece preocupante que el servicio sea tan caro.
items.english: It seems worrying to me that the service is so expensive.

items.spanish: Es importante que las decisiones sean transparentes.
items.english: It is important that decisions be transparent.

sections.content: Watch *me* *parece*: on its own it works like *creo* *que* and takes the indicative, but *me* *parece* *preocupante* que switches to the subjunctive, because now it's an evaluation (*preocupante*) rather than a plain assertion.
